# Affinity mapping

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

A method that clusters research findings or design ideas into themes. Nielsen Norman Group describes the steps: the team writes each idea, observation, or data point on its own sticky note, then sorts the notes into groups, and then names each group.
